entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.2.3
entry.summary: Companion screen gains a **pairing QR** at `/qr.svg`: tap the `PAIR` line in the panel and scan it from a second phone instead of typing the address. The QR is generated from the plugin's own interface address at request time. Encoder: Project Nayuki's qrcodegen (MIT, pinned), vendored - nothing fetched at runtime.

entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.2.2
entry.summary: **The plugin serves its own panel** on the LAN, port 8101: ECHO, TAPE and MACRO, read and write. `TEC_HTTP=0` disables the listener, `TEC_HTTP_RW=0` makes it read-only, writes need an `X-TEC: 1` header. **Switches.** ARM, PING-PONG and SYNC were drawn outside the reachable area of the 1280x628 screen and could not be touched at all. They are rocker controls inside the panel now. **Rack is the default interface** (`SKIN_DEFAULT_IDX`), and `redeploy.sh` re-applies whichever interface `ui.txt` name

entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.2.1
entry.summary: Vendor name change: the plugin now ships under **LarryDaimond** (was `MPCTE`), so it installs into `/sdcard/Synths/LarryDaimond - VST - MPC Tape Echo/` and the skins carry the new name. The uid is unchanged, so a saved project and an existing install keep working: `install.sh` replaces the old entry. entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release, built from the source in this repository. **Tested:** MPC Live II, MPC OS 3.9.1.2 (2026-10-26). **CPU:** worst p99 19.8 %, worst block 20.2 % of a 2.9 ms block -> **WARN**. One or two instances in a project. The spring tank is ~60 % of the load; see the README for the profile and why PASS is not reachable without changing the reverb. **Requires MPC OS 3.x** (the skin uses TUI format version 2).
